name: Evans Food Company
old_description: Evans Food Company was founded in 1991 out of a passion for food and an entrepreneurial spirit.
about:
Evans Food Company operates from Springfield, Missouri, where it was founded in 1991 out of a passion for food and an entrepreneurial spirit. The company began as a provider of high-quality food manufacturing for retail packaging and food service production.

Today it functions as a co-pack and private-label manufacturer and food distributor, specializing in sauces, dressings, and side items. Its services span recipe formulation and costing, label design, production runs from small to large batches, climate-controlled warehousing, and digital marketing support. The facility handles both low- and high-volume orders, and the company also markets its own brands, including The Grove Salsa, Hopsing Gourmet Sauces, and Chill CBD Water.

Customers range from startup entrepreneurs to established food businesses seeking co-packing or private-label assistance for products such as salsas, hot sauces, soups, and condiments. The company also partners with the Fight for the Forgotten initiative, directing proceeds from Chill CBD Water sales to clean-water projects in the Congo.

Evans Food Company emphasizes a blend of culinary expertise and business acumen, offering in-house graphic design, a typical lead time of two to three weeks after payment receipt, and a commitment to replicating exact flavors across every batch.
